paper_title: Near-Quantum-Noise Axion Dark Matter Search at CAPP around 9.5 $μ$eV
notes: CAPP haloscope search over 9.39-9.51 ueV (2.2704-2.3000 GHz). Reports coupling sensitivity of 2.7-fold above KSVZ level at 90% CL with rho_a=0.45 GeV/cm^3. The exclusion limit is from Fig. 4 which is not numerically tabulated; data_points are approximate estimates based on KSVZ-level coupling (~10^-15 GeV^-1 range at this mass) scaled by 2.7.
